title: Video in downloading process while being dragged don't get a thumb until it's dropped
line: A file you are dragging on the desktop now shows its thumbnail as soon as it is ready, instead of only after you drop it.
explanation: While icons are dragged, Folder View hides the dragged items and shows a picture of them grabbed once when the drag starts, so a thumbnail that arrives mid-drag (like a download finishing) only appears after the drop. On top of that, Qt reads QDrag's pixmap only when the drag starts, so even a new picture could not be shown. The Qt change makes QDrag::setPixmap() during a running drag repaint the drag icon. The Plasma change keeps the dragged items' delegates loaded (hidden) and, when a dragged item's icon changes, regrabs it and rebuilds the drag picture.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: update the drag image when a dragged icon changes

A thumbnail that arrived while its file was dragged only showed after
the drop, because the drag image was grabbed once. Keep dragged items'
delegates loaded and regrab them when their icon changes mid-drag.

BUG: 518070
